description: Wiring contract tests. Imports each sentinel module and checks: (1) no module imports duckdb directly (2) all daemons have run() function (3) all FastAPI apps have /health route defined (4) all modules have __name__==__main__ guard if they have run(). Uses importlib to load each module. Checks ast.parse for duckdb.connect pattern. Writes WIRING_TEST_REPORT.md with pass/fail per module. Run: python3 tests/test_wiring.py. sys.exit(1) on any failure.
